title: Nachuma ben Efkashyon (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in a baraita in [Yoma 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.28b.1), in a dispute involving R. Yishmael, R. Akiva, Nachuma ben Efkashyon and Matya ben Shmuel. Hyman reports the reading R. Chanina ben Efkashyon in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked baraita gives separate formulations for announcing the morning light in the Temple.

The linked Bavli and [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2631&lang=en) also name Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira as a fifth speaker. Hyman gives the variant Chanina from Dikdukei Soferim.
